mapper.select: select last_event_id as "lastEventId", cast(state as text) as "state" from abr_growth_cursor where cursor_name = #{cursorName} for update skip locked
mapper.update: update abr_growth_cursor set last_event_id = #{lastEventId}, state = cast(coalesce(#{state}, '{}') as jsonb), update_time = now() where cursor_name = #{cursorName}
